units.source_text: 书法拙劣，故意用挥洒的笔法来文饰，品格毕竟不高。

en.t: The handwriting was poor, and though it was deliberately dressed up with a free, sweeping brush style, its quality was still not very refined.

units.source_text: 源氏公子回想起那天晚上下棋时灯光中的面貌来。

en.t: Prince Genji recalled the face he had seen in the lamplight that night while they were playing go.

units.source_text: 他想：“那时和她对弈的那个正襟危坐的人，实在令人难忘。

en.t: He thought, "The person who sat so formally while playing against her then was truly unforgettable.

units.source_text: 至于这个人呢，另有一种风度：挑达不拘，口没遮拦。”

en.t: As for this one, she has a different kind of charm: carefree and unrestrained, with no guard on her tongue."

units.source_text: 他想到这光景，觉得这个人也不讨厌。

en.t: Thinking of that scene, he felt that this person was not unpleasant either.

units.source_text: 这时候他忘记了苦头，又想再惹起一个风流名声来。

en.t: By then he had forgotten his troubles and once again wanted to stir up a reputation for amorous adventure.
